examples.en: He was not so quick a learner as his brother.
examples.zh: 他学东西不像他哥哥那么快。

examples.en: I am not a learner as such – I used to ride a bike years ago.
examples.zh: 我不是个准确意义上的初学者–我多年前常常骑自行车。

examples.en: The star refers to items which are intended for the advanced learner.
examples.zh: 标有星号的项目是给高阶学习者的。
